title: The Wrong Hotel Booking · 独立口语迁移
instructions: 先完成示范段的跟读诊断，再用不同人物、信息或立场录制自己的完整回答。示范与自由回答分别取证，服务未提供完整听音评阅时保持待评。
reference: Last month, my friend Lisa and I planned a trip to Hangzhou. We wanted to see the lake and eat good food. I booked a hotel online. I chose a small hotel near the lake. The price was good, so I paid quickly. I did not check the address carefully. This was my first mistake. On Friday, we took a train to Hangzhou. We arrived at 3 p. m. We walked to the hotel. But the hotel was not there! The address was wrong. It was a shop, not a hotel. Lisa was tired and hungry. I felt very sorry. First, we went to a café and sat down. Then I called the hotel. A woman answered. She said, “Your booking is for next month.” I made a mistake! After that, I looked for a new hotel on my phone. We found a small hotel near the train station. It was clean and quiet.

Do you like to travel?
Where did you go last year?

Describe a travel problem you had. You should say: where you went, what the problem was, what you did, and how you felt.

Part 3
Why do people make mistakes when they book hotels?
How can people avoid travel problems?
